description: This source file implements utility functions for the Slap Obj Entity Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It includes functions for resolving call descriptions of input, output, and return values, as well as resolving call bridges and options for method invocation, primarily used in the context of object property and method management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOeoResolveCallDescrI(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * call_description,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Resolves the call description string for input parameters, parsing syntax and content type tokens and populating a parameter list accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOeoResolveCallDescrO(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * call_description,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Resolves the call description string for output parameters, intended to prepare a variable based on the description tokens.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOeoResolveCallDescrR(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * call_description,SLAP_VARIABLE * return_var)
methods.description: Resolves the call description string for return values, initializing a variable with syntax and content type info.

methods.name: ULONG SlapOeoResolveCallBridge(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * method_name)
methods.description: Determines the bridge ID (internal call routing identifier) for a given method name.

methods.name: ULONG SlapOeoResolveCallOption(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * method_name,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Determines the call options (such as skipping certain translation layers) based on method descriptors and object properties.
